Family Medicine.title: Family Medicine
Family Medicine.description: Provides general healthcare for people of all ages, from children to older adults.
Family Medicine.whenToVisit: For routine checkups, preventive care, and common health concerns.

Internal Medicine.title: Internal Medicine
Internal Medicine.description: Focuses on preventing, diagnosing, and treating medical conditions in adults.
Internal Medicine.whenToVisit: For adult healthcare, complex medical problems, and chronic disease management.

Pediatrics.title: Pediatrics
Pediatrics.description: Provides healthcare for babies, children, and teenagers.
Pediatrics.whenToVisit: For childhood illnesses, growth monitoring, and routine child checkups.

Cardiology.title: Cardiology
Cardiology.description: Specializes in the heart and blood vessels.
Cardiology.whenToVisit: For heart-related symptoms or evaluation of cardiovascular conditions.

Dermatology.title: Dermatology
Dermatology.description: Diagnoses and treats conditions affecting the skin, hair, and nails.
Dermatology.whenToVisit: For persistent skin problems, hair loss, nail disorders, or changing skin lesions.

Orthopedics.title: Orthopedics
Orthopedics.description: Treats problems involving bones, joints, muscles, and ligaments.
Orthopedics.whenToVisit: For musculoskeletal pain, injuries, or difficulty moving a joint.

Neurology.title: Neurology
Neurology.description: Focuses on diseases of the brain, spinal cord, and nerves.
Neurology.whenToVisit: For recurring neurological symptoms, seizures, or persistent nerve-related problems.

Gastroenterology.title: Gastroenterology
Gastroenterology.description: Treats disorders of the digestive system, including the stomach, intestines, and liver.
Gastroenterology.whenToVisit: For persistent digestive symptoms or diagnosed digestive system disorders.

Pulmonology.title: Pulmonology
Pulmonology.description: Specializes in diseases affecting the lungs and breathing passages.
Pulmonology.whenToVisit: For persistent breathing difficulties or ongoing lung conditions.

Endocrinology.title: Endocrinology
Endocrinology.description: Treats hormone-related disorders and diseases of hormone-producing glands.
Endocrinology.whenToVisit: For complex hormone problems or diabetes that needs specialist management.

Nephrology.title: Nephrology
Nephrology.description: Focuses on kidney diseases and the body's fluid and electrolyte balance.
Nephrology.whenToVisit: For diagnosed kidney disease or persistent abnormalities in kidney function.

Rheumatology.title: Rheumatology
Rheumatology.description: Treats inflammatory and autoimmune conditions affecting joints and connective tissues.
Rheumatology.whenToVisit: For persistent joint swelling, inflammatory pain, or suspected autoimmune conditions.

Oncology.title: Oncology
Oncology.description: Specializes in diagnosing and treating cancer.
Oncology.whenToVisit: For specialist evaluation after a suspected or confirmed cancer diagnosis.

Hematology.title: Hematology
Hematology.description: Focuses on diseases of the blood and blood-forming organs.
Hematology.whenToVisit: For complex blood disorders or abnormal blood test results requiring specialist assessment.

General Surgery.title: General Surgery
General Surgery.description: Provides surgical care for a range of conditions affecting the abdomen and soft tissues.
General Surgery.whenToVisit: When a clinician recommends surgical evaluation or a condition may require an operation.

Neurosurgery.title: Neurosurgery
Neurosurgery.description: Provides surgical treatment for conditions affecting the brain, spine, and nervous system.
Neurosurgery.whenToVisit: When a specialist recommends evaluation for a condition that may require neurosurgery.

Urology.title: Urology
Urology.description: Treats disorders of the urinary tract and male reproductive system.
Urology.whenToVisit: For persistent urinary symptoms, prostate problems, or diagnosed urological conditions.

Ophthalmology.title: Ophthalmology
Ophthalmology.description: Provides medical and surgical care for the eyes and vision.
Ophthalmology.whenToVisit: For ongoing eye problems, changes in vision, or eye disease management.

ENT.title: Ear, Nose and Throat (ENT)
ENT.description: Treats conditions affecting the ears, nose, throat, and related head and neck structures.
ENT.whenToVisit: For persistent ear, nose, throat, or hearing problems.

Psychiatry.title: Psychiatry
Psychiatry.description: Provides medical assessment and treatment for mental health conditions.
Psychiatry.whenToVisit: For mental health concerns that may benefit from medical assessment or treatment.

Psychology.title: Psychology
Psychology.description: Focuses on emotional wellbeing, behavior, and psychological assessment and therapy.
Psychology.whenToVisit: For emotional difficulties, coping strategies, or psychological therapy.

Gynecology.title: Gynecology
Gynecology.description: Focuses on reproductive and menstrual health.
Gynecology.whenToVisit: For menstrual concerns, reproductive health, or routine gynecological care.

Obstetrics.title: Obstetrics
Obstetrics.description: Provides medical care during pregnancy, childbirth, and the period after delivery.
Obstetrics.whenToVisit: For pregnancy-related care and follow-up during and after pregnancy.

Geriatrics.title: Geriatrics
Geriatrics.description: Focuses on the health needs of older adults.
Geriatrics.whenToVisit: For complex healthcare needs associated with aging.

Radiology.title: Radiology
Radiology.description: Uses medical imaging to help diagnose and sometimes treat diseases.
Radiology.whenToVisit: When a clinician recommends imaging or image-guided diagnostic procedures.
